AuthorizeFileUpload.description_en: Grants OSS PostObject direct upload authorization for callers to upload files directly to the specified bucket and object key, and then use the object URL as OssFileUrl to create a parsing task
AuthorizeFileUpload.description_zh: 调用方将文件直接上传到响应指定的 Bucket/ObjectKey，再将对象 URL 作为 OssFileUrl 创建解析任务

DescribeDocParserJobResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a document parsing task
DescribeDocParserJobResult.description_zh: 获取文档解析任务的结果

DescribeDocParserJobStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a document parsing task
DescribeDocParserJobStatus.description_zh: 查询文档解析任务的状态
